C0012.title: Shanghai Crackdown on Consumer Voucher Fraud Leads to 18 Arrests
C0012.summary: On January 18, 2025, Shanghai police, in coordination with relevant authorities, dismantled two criminal cases involving consumer voucher fraud and arrested 18 suspects.
